name: Levi’s x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'All-Star'
story_html: The Levi’s x Air Jordan 3 Retro 'All-Star' launched exclusively in LA as part of the 2026 NBA All-Star Weekend festivities. The legacy silhouette sports a white leather upper with washed indigo denim detailing. The cotton twill material appears on the forefoot and heel overlay, as well as the collar and eyestay. The latter is marked with the iconic red Levi's tab on the lateral side. A matching red Jumpman adorns the tongue, while Nike Air branding embellishes the molded heel tab. The sneaker is mounted on a lightweight polyurethane midsole with visible Air-Sole cushioning.
